answer_1.quote: We compare the performance of two recent multistage RAG pipelines (ReadAgent and RAPTOR) against three baselines (Vanilla RAG, the full-document baseline, and DOS RAG) on three long-context question-answering tasks (∞Bench, QuALITY and NarrativeQA).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are answers to questions, either multiple-choice selections or short factual responses based on provided context.
